_checkAndCallTransfer performs an external call to the recipient's onTransferReceived, handing control to untrusted code before state is settled.
The recipient callback can reenter ERC1363/ERC20 functions such as transfer and balances while the outer call continues.
_checkAndCallApprove performs an external call to the spender's onApprovalReceived, handing control to untrusted code.
The spender callback can reenter token functions during approveAndCall execution.
_msgSender() (msg.sender) is passed to _checkAndCallTransfer as the operator argument.
approveAndCall uses _msgSender() to authorize the allowance being set.
transferFrom calls the internal _transfer to move balances.
transferFromAndCall combines balance movement with the receiver callback.
